name: Vostok-3
about: Vostok-3 (1962 A MU 1), a crewed vehicle (Vostok3A), launched 1962 Aug 11. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1962 Aug 14), held fixed
